prompts.title: Academic Writing Task 1 - Bar Chart
prompts.prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of households in owned and rented accommodation in England and Wales between 1918 and 2011.
prompts.instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

prompts.title: Academic Writing Task 1 - Line Graph
prompts.prompt: The graph below shows the consumption of fish and some different kinds of meat in a European country between 1979 and 2004.
prompts.instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

prompts.title: General Training Task 1 - Formal Letter
prompts.prompt: You have recently attended a course at a local college or training center. Write a letter to the course director.
prompts.instructions: In your letter: - Explain why you chose the course - Describe what you liked about the course - Suggest how the course could be improved. Write at least 150 words.

prompts.title: Academic Writing Task 2 - Technology
prompts.prompt: Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others, however, believe there are better alternative ways of reducing crime.
prompts.instructions: Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.

prompts.title: Academic Writing Task 2 - Education
prompts.prompt: Some people believe that universities should focus on providing academic skills, while others think they should prepare students for employment.
prompts.instructions: Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.

prompts.title: General Training Task 2 - Environment
prompts.prompt: Some people say that the main environmental problem of our time is the loss of particular species of plants and animals. Others say that there are more important environmental problems.
prompts.instructions: Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
